comment: The sole error was C versus D: the deeper, narrower residual GELU network beat the shallow residual GELU network under identical Adagrad settings and terminal-only LN. I over-weighted possible depth-related attenuation; residual paths and terminal normalization make that penalty uncertain. Additional nonlinear composition is a plausible explanation, not a measured mechanism. K1065 does not cover four-feature XOR or justify this Adagrad ordering; K1016 cautions against favoring D’s width. Backtesting found no matched Adagrad residual-depth pairs in the lab. Equal-LN, same-optimizer residual XOR pairs favored deeper models only 1/12 times across four sets. History supplied two comparable Adagrad contrasts, but only one revealed their ordering, favoring deeper. No general depth rule is supported.
